frame.definition: Candidate journal frame, requiring bibliographic verification and a recorded coverage decision before retrieval. Primary analysis includes research articles; reviews require a separate frame/run.

credential_note: Optional existing user-provided verified key only. Never create keys/accounts. OpenAlex may require a key to follow cursor pagination beyond the first page.
coverage_note: A fixed journal frame estimates only that frame, not all geoscience. Add oceanography, atmospheric, food-system and interdisciplinary journals through a preregistered expansion if those communities are in scope. Do not select papers using AI or modality keywords for the denominator.
